**Step:** [step-4](../README.md) — Does a checkpointed DAG run the whole zoo end-to-end, resumably, from one command — and what does it cost in wall-clock and dollars?

## The claim

P4-5: the zoo DAG resumes from any stage without recomputing a finished stage or a finished fan-out lane; a run killed mid-fan-out and restarted with the same config reproduces the uninterrupted run's outputs.

**Prediction if true.** With counting Deps injected, a workflow killed inside fan_out after the first lane and restarted makes exactly one load_records, one load_registry, one load_pairs and one score call per lane in total across both attempts; the restarted run's merged.json, per-model report JSON and merged report are identical (generation timestamps aside) to an uninterrupted run of the same config, and exactly one manifest exists for the run id. On real data, a second mva-zoo run of the same config restores all eight stages and finishes in a fraction of the first run's wall-clock.

**What would refute it.** Any deps call counter above one for a stage or lane finished before the kill; any output byte-differing from the uninterrupted run beyond its generation timestamps; more than one manifest for the run id; or a second real-data run that recomputes a stage whose inputs did not change.

## Evidence

| # | Direction | Strength | Kind | Observation | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 159 | supports | 0.80 | measurement | Kill test: the fixture DAG is killed inside fan_out after two of four lanes; across the killed attempt and the restart the injected Deps counts one load_records, one load_registry, one load_pairs and one score call per FINISHED lane, the restart's outputs equal an uninterrupted run's, and exactly one manifest exists (tests/test_zoo_resume.py, 11 green). | `docs/iteration4/step-4/methodology/135-a-resume-that-is-tested-by-killing-the-run.md` |
| 160 | supports | 0.70 | measurement | Real data: two consecutive mva-zoo run calls on the same config; the eight stages took 541.21 s then 0.73 s (741x), seven of eight restored. registry_check re-ran because a parallel session had added a roster fragment, but its content was unchanged so nothing downstream re-ran - content-addressed, not name-addressed. | `docs/iteration4/step-4/methodology/135-a-resume-that-is-tested-by-killing-the-run.md` |
